UEP_Story_Map_Author.title: Story Map: Author journey on the Unified Editorial Platform
UEP_Story_Map_Author.persona: Dr. Priya Nair, a postdoctoral chemist in her early 30s, is preparing a manuscript for JACS

lanes.name: Prepare the MSC
lanes.step: Step 1: Get the MSC right before I submit
cards: Today: unsure which journal rules apply; a desk reject costs weeks
Select the target journal (cover thumbnail confirms the choice)
Download the journal MSC template with guidelines
Upload the .docx and see an organized preview of the MSC

lanes.name: Integrity and Fitment
lanes.step: Step 2: Know my score and how to fix it
cards: Format and required details validated (title, authors, ORCID)
Integrity score 1-10 across 7 weighted checks
Issues ranked critical / major / minor with How to fix
Journal fit % with best-fit journal or transfer path

lanes.name: Submit and Track
lanes.step: Step 3: Submit with confidence and stay informed
cards: Score above 6 = PASS enables Submit; FAIL asks for a fix
My submissions shows status, decision and reviewer feedback
Revise: upload the revision and re-check before re-submitting
First-time-right submission, fewer desk rejects, clear next step

UEP_Story_Map_Editor_TR.title: Story Map: Editor journey for Triage and Routing
UEP_Story_Map_Editor_TR.persona: Mark Ellis, an Associate Editor in his 40s, triages 40+ new MSCs a week across several journals

lanes.name: Triage the Inflow
lanes.step: Step 1: See what needs my attention now
cards: Today: no single view of integrity, fit or age of new MSCs
Dashboard: Open & In Progress and Complete tabs with live counts
Time elapsed in green / amber / red with filters and paging
KPI tiles and a collapsible KPIs & Metrics panel

lanes.name: Route to Reviewer
lanes.step: Step 2: Get the right reviewer on it fast
cards: Look up reviewers ranked by availability and expertise
Send the invitation e-mail with an accept / decline link
Refresh icon rechecks a pending invitation
Review unlocks on accept; a decline frees the MSC

lanes.name: Review and Decide
cards: MSC Analysis: Summary, Integrity PASS / FAIL, Journal Fitment %
Annotate the immutable MSC: 6-colour highlights, underline, comment
Accept / Reject / Transfer / Revise / Assign to PE
Faster, consistent and auditable triage and routing decisions
